Name: Psyduck Pet Replacement (includes audio)
Author: 2sober
Description:
Replaces your pet with a psyduck. It can even say its name (see optional files)!


Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music [/url]is required for the optional English and German audio.

The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4232]Pet Interaction [/url]mod is not required but strongly recommended to enhance the experience.


[b]Have more than one pet?[/b]
If you have multiple pets, you can now use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to select which types of pets should get replaced.
By default all pets get changed into psyduck.
However, the sound can only be changed for all cats / all dogs at once by installing the optional files.
